imagineWorkflowDocumentation.summary: The Grok Build Imagine skill documents that image-generation tools return real sandbox file paths under artifacts and instructs the agent not to invent paths.

audit.metric: mean absolute RGB channel error with RMSE retained as a secondary diagnostic

interpretation.supported: Each of the 192 current release story images resolves to a different historical Grok Imagine artifact with a low visual error after deterministic normalization; there are zero collisions and two unused historical Imagine artifacts.
interpretation.notSupported: This technical audit does not by itself establish legal ownership, copyrightability, non-infringement, or permission to use third-party material. Rights provenance is intentionally handled in a separate change.
